basic_details.job_title: DHS Goa Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in for 58 Surgeon, Medical Officer & Other Posts
basic_details.post_name: Surgeon, Orthopedic Surgeon, Anesthetist, and other posts

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: Age limit: Not exceeding 45 years for posts where specified, or up to 60 years for specific medical posts (Surgeon, Orthopedic Surgeon, Anesthetist, Radiologist, Physician, Psychiatrist, Echo Cardiologist, Intensivist / Consultant (ICU)). Age is relaxable as per instructions/orders issued by the Government.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | surgeon / orthopedic surgeon / anesthetist / radiologist / physician / psychiatrist: A recognized Medical qualification included in the First or Second Schedule or Part II of the Third Schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) to the Indian Medical Council Act 1956. Holders of educational qualifications included in Part- II of the Third Schedule should also fulfill the conditions stipulated in the sub-section (3) of the section 13 of the I.M.C. Act, 1956. | echo cardiologist: (i) Post-Graduate degree qualifications in the General Medicine or Post-Graduate degree qualification in Respiratory Medicine with fellowship in ECHO Cardiology OR Post-Graduate degree qualifications in the General Medicine or Post-Graduate degree qualification in Respiratory Medicine with certificate in ECHO Cardiology and 01 year experience. | intensivist / consultant (icu): A recognized medical qualification included in the first or second schedule or part II of the third schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act 1956. Holders of educational qualification included in Part II of the third schedule should also fulfill the conditions stipulated in sub section (3) of section 13 of the IMC Act 1956 AND MD Anesthesia / Equivalent degree OR MD in general medicine / Equivalent degree with 1 year experience in intensive care OR MD in respiratory medicine with 1 year experience in intensive care OR MBBS Graduate with 2 years certificate course in critical medicine/intensive care with 1 year work experience. (Note: For MBBS Graduate with MCI recognized certificate course in critical medicine/intensive care, remuneration is Rs. 1,60,000/-) | medical officer: (i) Medical qualification included in the First or Second Schedule or Part II of the Third Schedule (other than licentiate qualifications) to the Indian Medical Council Act 1956. Holders of educational qualifications included in Part- II of the Third Schedule should fulfill the conditions stipulated in the section 18 (3) of the I.M.C. Act, 1956 or a degree of Goa Medical School. (ii) Completion of compulsory rotating Internship. | occupational therapist: Master in Occupational Therapy / Bachelor in Occupational Therapy from a recognized institution. (Desirable: 01 year experience working with children and interest in Pediatric Neuro-rehabilitation) | speech therapist: M. Sc or B. Sc in Audiology and Speech Language Pathology from a recognized institution. (Desirable: 6 months experience in Speech Therapy) | behavior therapist: Graduate in any field from a recognized institution with specialized training in Behavior Therapy for Autism from reputed institute. (Desirable: 1 year experience in Behavior Therapy) | technical staff (engineer): B.E. (Mechanical) or B.E. in Biomedical Engineering with one year experience.

salary_details.intensivist / consultant (icu): Rs. 2,00,000/- per month (consolidated); Rs. 1,60,000/- for MBBS Graduate with MCI recognized certificate course in critical medicine/intensive care

selection_process: Selection is based on a walk-in interview preceded by document verification.
how_to_apply: Check the specified walk-in date and reporting time for your desired post.
Prepare your application along with original certificates and testimonials.
Organize self-attested copies of required certificates.
Report for document verification at the Chamber of the Director, Directorate of Health Services, Campal, Panaji-Goa.
Attend the walk-in interview on the scheduled date and time.
important_instructions: Candidates have to report for document verification along with application, original and photocopy of certificates and testimonials as per dates specified. For posts from Sr. No. 1 to 9: Self attested copies of birth certificate, educational qualifications, Internship completion certificate, Goa Medical Council registration, 15 years residence in Goa & experience certificate wherever applicable are required. For posts from Sr. No. 10 to 13: Self attested copies of birth certificate, educational qualification, valid employment card, 15 years residence in Goa & experience certificate wherever applicable are required. Candidates for posts at Sr. No. 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 10 & 12 have to report for document verification at 9.30 a.m. Candidates for posts at Sr. No. 2, 4, 6, 8, 11 & 13 have to report for document verification at 2.00 p.m. Late reporting after 10.00 am / 2.30 pm will not be considered for interview. No TA/DA shall be paid to attend Walk-In-Interview. Knowledge of Konkani is desirable for all posts.

content_sections.heading: DHS Goa Surgeon – Quick Summary
content_sections.text: Who is recruiting? Directorate of Health Services Goa (DHS Goa) Which posts? Candidates meeting specific educational qualifications and 15 years residence in Goa Application start date: Already open (Walk-in dates from 19 October 2026 to 29 October 2026) Last date: Walk-in dates vary by post Application mode: Walk-in Interview Job location: Goa

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in DHS Goa Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 58 vacancies available across various posts including Surgeon, Medical Officer, and Therapists.

faq.answer: Candidates for these posts must report for document verification at 9.30 a.m.
